note: Radio's cast: specialties that each answer ONE question the owner asks at the end of a day, from a source no other specialty reads, with a never-says list, so two of them can't say the same thing. The same cast for every project (one project per episode). Each is bound to one Kokoro voice and one stereo position for its lifetime; radio/voices.lock records every voice ever held. Brainstorm (QR-26): each specialty also has a brainstorm angle (the one question it answers about the owner's question) and its own source kinds; a specialty added from the web (QR-27) is brainstorm-only (`recap: false`) and reads the question's general hits. QR-39 (10-17): the old daemon's knower lenses return as brainstorm-only specialties — Cartographer (where things are; `layout`), Historian (what was decided over time, pivots and reversals; `history`), Chronicler (what happened lately and where Sang left off; `timeline`).

reads.speaks_when: always: what the day was, the questions, the sign-off
reads.never: a claim beyond the day's facts

reads.question: What actually changed today?
reads.never: whether it's proven, why it was decided, what's next

brainstorm.angle: What would it take to build, and what already exists?

reads.question: Is that actually proven?
reads.speaks_when: a claim on air has evidence to read
reads.never: what changed (it cites the Builder's line number); never an open doubt: 'proven by X' or 'not proven yet, the one check is Y'

brainstorm.angle: What is true today, and what would prove the idea works?

reads.question: What did we decide today, and what did it cost?
reads.speaks_when: a ruling was taken or a design note changed

brainstorm.angle: Does it fit what we decided, or break it?

reads.question: Does a user notice any of it?
reads.speaks_when: something user-visible changed, or the product's story moved

brainstorm.angle: Would a user want it, and what would they notice?

reads.question: What's waiting on Sang?
reads.speaks_when: invited (--with operator), or something broke in the window
reads.never: anything already done; on a break, anything but the break and the one act that fixes it

brainstorm.angle: What would it cost to run, and what would wait on Sang?

reads.never: how parts connect, whether it works, what to build

brainstorm.angle: Where in the project does this live, and what would it touch?

reads.never: what the code does today, what to build next

brainstorm.angle: Have we been here before, and what happened?

reads.never: why it was decided, whether it is proven

brainstorm.angle: What happened lately that bears on this, and where did Sang leave off?
